	GPU0	GPU1	GPU2	CPU Affinity	NUMA Affinity	GPU NUMA ID
GPU0	 X 	PIX	SYS	0-15	0	N/A
GPU1	PIX	 X 	NODE	0-15	0	N/A
GPU2	SYS	NODE	 X 	16-31	1	N/A

Legend:

  X    = Self
  SYS  = Connection traversing PCIe and the SMP interconnect between NUMA nodes
  NODE = Connection traversing PCIe and host bridges within a NUMA node
  PIX  = Connection traversing at most a single PCIe bridge
